name: VENOM MD BOT
description: A clean, secure and extensible bot for WhatsApp and Telegram by TAPRUSH EMP (Micheal). 633 commands, one deploy.

PLATFORM.description: Which platform to run: whatsapp, telegram, or both.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Required only when PLATFORM is telegram or both.

TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID.description: Your numeric Telegram user id from @userinfobot. Grants owner-only commands.

SESSION_ID.description: WhatsApp credential from the official VENOM session website. Leave blank for a Telegram-only deploy.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner WhatsApp number with country code, digits only. Leave blank for a Telegram-only deploy.

SESSION_NAMESPACE.description: Safe name for this bot session.

DATABASE_URL.description: Optional MongoDB URL for settings and session backup.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional Google Gemini key for the AI command.
